WELCOME.INTRO: I'm a fourth-year computer engineering student at Concordia University, in the co-op program (C.Edge). I enjoy building responsive, user-friendly applications, from full-stack web apps to embedded and IoT projects, and I keep improving my skills through real projects and new technologies.

ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.INTRO: I am Tonny Zhao, a computer engineering student passionate about software development, with a strong interest in front-end technologies like Angular. I recently designed and built a multilingual website for CREII, won first place at the GDG Polytechnique hackathon, and I currently lead technology and video game creation workshops with Fusion Jeunesse.

SECTIONS.HEADING: Who is responsible
SECTIONS.BODY: This website is run by Tonny Zhao, who is also the person in charge of protecting personal information. For any question or request, write to zhaotonny315@gmail.com.

SECTIONS.HEADING: What is collected and why
SECTIONS.BODY: The only personal information collected is what you enter in the contact form: your name, email address and message. It is used only to read and answer your message. It is not sold, shared for marketing, or used to build a profile about you.

SECTIONS.HEADING: How your message is sent
SECTIONS.BODY: The contact form uses EmailJS, an email delivery service, to forward your message to my inbox. Your information may therefore be processed outside Québec, including in the United States, under that provider's security measures.

SECTIONS.HEADING: How long it is kept
SECTIONS.BODY: Your message is kept in my email only for as long as needed to answer you and follow up, and is deleted afterwards or sooner if you ask.

SECTIONS.HEADING: Cookies and preferences
SECTIONS.BODY: This website uses no cookies, analytics or advertising trackers. Your theme and language choices are saved only in your own browser (local storage) so they are remembered on your next visit. You can clear them at any time in your browser settings.

SECTIONS.HEADING: Third-party content
SECTIONS.BODY: To display fonts, icons and project previews, your browser loads files from Google Fonts, jsDelivr, YouTube, WordPress.com and GitHub. These providers may receive technical data such as your IP address, under their own privacy policies.

SECTIONS.HEADING: Your rights
SECTIONS.BODY: You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal information, or withdraw your consent, at any time by writing to zhaotonny315@gmail.com. You may also file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec.
